g.text: Performance spread across checkpoints at fixed computation
Fixed-compute checkpoint trajectories, not budget curves or confidence intervals; GFLOPs are shown in the legends.
Feature-loss-only retains GT boundary weighting. Epochs denote additional decoder training on a fixed anchor.
